P. 10. It is of 5 kinds: --कार्ये निमित्ते सामान्ये विशेषे प्रस्तुते सति . तदन्यस्य वचस्तुल्ये तुल्यस्येति च पंचधा .. i. e. when the subject matter is viewed (a) as an effect, information of which is conveyed by stating the cause; (b) when viewed as a cause by stating the effect; (c) when viewed as a general assertion by stating a particular instance; (d) when viewed as a particular instance by stating a general assertion; and (e) when viewed as similar by stating what is similar to it, see K. P. 10; and S. D. 706 for examples.

अ-प्रतिनोद m. not repelling, MaitrS.; PBr.
अ-प्रतिपण्य mfn. not to be bartered or exchanged.

2. अ-प्रतिरूप mf(आ)n. not corresponding with, unfit, ŚBr. xiv
odious, disagreeable, R. &c. (For 1. See अ-प्रति.)
a: अप्रतिरूप — a. 1 Not corresponding with, unfit. --2 Of unequalled form. --3 Incomparable (in a good or bad sense). --Comp. --कथा incomparable talk (संगणिका), उत्तरवाक्यरहिता वाक्. --वीर्यं irresistible power.

a: अप्रतिरथ — a. or --थः 1 (A hero) who has no प्रतिरथ or rival warrior, a matchless or unrivalled warrior; दौष्यंतिमप्रतिरथं तनयं निवेश्य Ś. 4. 19, Ś. 7, 7. 33. --2 Matchless Mv. 1. 46. --थः N. of a Ṛṣi. --थः, --थं N. of a hymn composed by अ˚; यद्यात्रामंगलं साम तदप्रतिरथं विदुः.

m: अ-प्रतिसाध्य mfn. incurable, Viṣṇ., Sch.
अ-प्रतिसंख्या f. ‘not observing’, in comp. with
inconsiderateness, Jātakam.

m: अ-प्रतिसंख्या—निरोध m. the unobserved annihilation of an object, Buddh.

v: tri॰ na pratItA saMKyA yasya uttarapadalopaH । ayamekaH ayameka ityAkArApekzAbudDyaBAvena 1 pratyekasaMKyAgrahaRABAvAdanupalabDasaMKyAke vastuni । pratisaMKyA vudDiviSezaH । aBAve na॰ ta॰ । 2 viSezabudDyaBAve strI ।
a: अप्रतिसंख्य — a. Unobserved, unnoticed; ˚ख्य (ख्या) निरोधः unobserved nullity, annihilation of an object; one of the three topics included by the Buddhas under the category of निरूप, the other two being प्रतिसंख्यानिरोध wilful destruction, as of a jar by a mallet, and आकाश the ethereal element.

m: अ-प्रतिसंक्रम mfn. having no intermixture.
a: अप्रतिसंक्रम — a. Having no intermixture.

m: अ-प्रतिस्तब्ध mfn. unrestrained, Bhaṭṭ. (cf. अ-प्रतिष्टब्ध above.)
अ-प्रतिवाणि mfn. unhindered, Divyāv.
अ-प्रतिवादिन् mfn. not contradicting, TS. &c.
अ-प्रतिवीर्यारम्भ mfn. not having sufficient strength to undertake anything, SaddhP.
अ-प्रति—वीर्य mfn. of irresistible power, R. iv, 35, 4 and 38, 13.
अ—प्रति—वीर्य mfn., unequalled, matchless, irresistible, MBh.; R.
a: अप्रतिवीर्य — a. Of incomparable prowess.

अ-प्रतियोधिन् mfn. ‘not having an adversary’, irresistible, MBh. (cf. g. गम्यादि.)

unlimited, BhP.; Jain.
a: अप्रतिष्ठित — a. Unsettled, unfixed, uncelebrated, obscure; unconsecrated, unholy. --तः An epithet of Viṣṇu.

अ-प्रतिष्कृत mfn. to whom nothing has been opposed, Nir.

अ-प्रतिष्टब्ध mfn. not supported by (instr.), Āp. (cf. अ-प्रतिस्तब्ध below.)

अ-प्रत्त mfn. (for अ-प्रदत्त), not given back, PBr.
a: अप्रत्त(˚प्रदत्त) — Not given away. --त्ता A girl, one not given away in marriage.

m: अ-प्रत्याख्यान n. non-refutation.

अ-प्रत्याख्येय mfn. not to be contradicted, undeniable.
अ-प्रत्यालभमान mfn. not offering resistance, ŚBr.
अ-प्रत्याम्नाय m. not a contradictory statement, RPrāt.

a: अप्रत्यक्ष — a. 1 Invisible, imperceptible. --2 Unknown. --3 Absent. --Comp. --शिष्ट a. not distinctly taught.

m: अ-प्रत्यक्ष—शिष्ट mfn. not distinctly taught.
अ-प्रत्यक्ष—ता f. imperceptibility.

having no affix.

I. 2. 45. --Comp. --स्थ a. (in gram.) not pertaining to an affix.

अ-प्रत्यृत mfn. (= अन्-अर्व), not encountering any resistance in (loc.), Nir.
a: अप्रत्यृत — a. Not attacked.

not exciting to action.
